Tropæolum.



Tropæolum majus. Indian Cress. Garden Nasturtium. N. O. Tropæolaceæ.
        Tincture of fresh plant.



Clinical. ─   Urine, fetid.



Characteristics. ─     Tropæolum
        is a native of Peru. It was called "Cress" and "Nasturtium" because the
        taste of the leaves was considered like the taste of cress, and they have been used like
        cress in salads. The seeds make pickles, and are used as a substitute for capers. A patient
        to whom Cooper gave   Trop  . noted that it made the urine
        extremely fetid in smell. On this keynote Cooper has relieved several cases of urinary
        difficulty, giving single doses of the Ø tincture.
